title: एकचत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 41 · Shiva gives Arjuna the Pashupata weapon

summary.en: Shiva tells Arjuna that he was Nara, companion of Narayana, in a former life, and grants him a boon. Arjuna asks for the terrible Pashupata weapon; Shiva teaches it to him with its secrets, restores his bow Gandiva, and departs with Uma.
summary.kn: ಹಿಂದಿನ ಜನ್ಮದಲ್ಲಿ ನೀನು ನಾರಾಯಣನ ಸಂಗಡಿಗ ನರ ಎಂದು ಹೇಳಿ ಶಿವನು ವರ ನೀಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅರ್ಜುನನು ಭಯಂಕರ ಪಾಶುಪತಾಸ್ತ್ರವನ್ನು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಶಿವನು ಅದರ ರಹಸ್ಯಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಉಪದೇಶಿಸಿ ಗಾಂಡೀವವನ್ನು ಮರಳಿಸಿ ಉಮೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ತೆರಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: शिव अर्जुन से कहते हैं कि पूर्वजन्म में वे नारायण के सहचर नर थे, और उन्हें वर देते हैं। अर्जुन भयंकर पाशुपत अस्त्र माँगते हैं; शिव उसके रहस्यों सहित उन्हें सिखाते हैं, गाण्डीव लौटाते हैं और उमा के साथ चले जाते हैं।
summary.te: పూర్వజన్మలో నీవు నారాయణుని సహచరుడు నరుడవని చెప్పి శివుడు వరమిస్తాడు. అర్జునుడు భయంకరమైన పాశుపతాస్త్రాన్ని కోరతాడు; శివుడు దాని రహస్యాలతో ఉపదేశించి, గాండీవాన్ని తిరిగి ఇచ్చి ఉమతో వెళ్తాడు.
summary.ta: முற்பிறவியில் நீ நாராயணரின் தோழனான நரன் என்று சொல்லி ஶிவன் வரம் அளிக்கிறார். அர்ஜுனன் கொடிய பாஶுபத அஸ்திரத்தைக் கேட்க, ஶிவன் அதன் ரகசியங்களுடன் கற்பித்து, காண்டீவத்தைத் திருப்பித் தந்து உமையுடன் செல்கிறார்.
summary.ml: പോകാൻ തുടങ്ങുമ്പോൾ താൻ പൂർവജന്മത്തിൽ നാരായണന്റെ സഖാവായ നരനായിരുന്നുവെന്ന് ശിവൻ അർജുനനോട് പറയുകയും ഒരു വരം നൽകുകയും ചെയ്യുന്നു. ഘോരമായ പാശുപതാസ്ത്രം ആവശ്യപ്പെടുന്ന അർജുനന് അതിന്റെ രഹസ്യങ്ങളോടെ ശിവൻ അത് പഠിപ്പിക്കുന്നു; ഗാണ്ഡീവം വില്ല് തിരികെ നൽകി ഉമയോടൊപ്പം പോകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.41; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: भगवानुवाच

meaning.en: The blessed one said:

verses.text:
नरस्त्वं पूर्वदेहे वै नारायणसहायवान् ।
बदर्यां तप्तवानुग्रं तपो वर्षायुतान्बहून् ॥

meaning.en: "In your former body you were Nara, with Narayana as your companion, and you practiced fierce austerity at Badari for many tens of thousands of years."

verses.text:
त्वयि वा परमं तेजो विष्णौ वा पुरुषोत्तमे ।
युवाभ्यां पुरुषाग्र्याभ्यां तेजसा धार्यते जगत् ॥

meaning.en: "The supreme energy is in you, or in Vishnu, the best of beings; by the energy of you two, foremost of men, the world is upheld."

verses.text:
शक्राभिषेके सुमहद्धनुर्जलदनिस्वनम् ।
प्रगृह्य दानवाः शस्तास्त्वया कृष्णेन च प्रभो ॥

meaning.en: "At Shakra's consecration, taking that very great bow with a voice like a thundercloud, you and Krishna, lord, slew the danavas."

verses.text:
एतत्तदेव गाण्डीवं तव पार्थ करोचितम् ।
मायामास्थाय यद्ग्रस्तं मया पुरुषसत्तम ।
तूणौ चाप्यक्षयौ भूयस्तव पार्थ यथोचितौ ॥

meaning.en: "This is that same Gandiva, Partha, fit for your hand, which I swallowed by taking on an illusion, best of men; and the two quivers, Partha, are again inexhaustible and as befits you."

verses.text:
प्रीतिमानस्मि वै पार्थ तव सत्यपराक्रम ।
गृहाण वरमस्मत्तः काङ्क्षितं यन्नरर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: "I am pleased with you, Partha, of true valor; take from me any boon you wish, bull among men."

verses.text:
न त्वया सदृशः कश्चित्पुमान्मर्त्येषु मानद ।
दिवि वा विद्यते क्षत्रं त्वत्प्रधानमरिंदम ॥

meaning.en: "No man among mortals, honorer of others, equals you, nor among the warriors in heaven is there one with you as chief, scourge of enemies."

verses.text: अर्जुन उवाच

meaning.en: Arjuna said:

verses.text:
भगवन्ददासि चेन्मह्यं कामं प्रीत्या वृषध्वज ।
कामये दिव्यमस्त्रं तद्घोरं पाशुपतं प्रभो ॥

meaning.en: "Blessed one, bull-bannered, if you give me a wish out of your favor, I desire that dreadful divine weapon, the Pashupata, lord."

verses.text:
यत्तद्ब्रह्मशिरो नाम रौद्रं भीमपराक्रमम् ।
युगान्ते दारुणे प्राप्ते कृत्स्नं संहरते जगत् ॥

meaning.en: "That which is called Brahmashiras, terrible and of fearsome power, which at the end of an age, when the dread time comes, withdraws the entire world,"

verses.text:
दहेयं येन संग्रामे दानवान्राक्षसांस्तथा ।
भूतानि च पिशाचांश्च गन्धर्वानथ पन्नगान् ॥

meaning.en: "with which I could burn in battle the danavas and rakshasas, creatures, pishachas, gandharvas and serpents,"

verses.text:
यतः शूलसहस्राणि गदाश्चोग्रप्रदर्शनाः ।
शराश्चाशीविषाकाराः संभवन्त्यनुमन्त्रिताः ॥

meaning.en: "from which, when charged with mantras, thousands of spears, fierce-looking maces and arrows like venomous snakes arise,"

verses.text:
युध्येयं येन भीष्मेण द्रोणेन च कृपेण च ।
सूतपुत्रेण च रणे नित्यं कटुकभाषिणा ॥

meaning.en: "with which I could fight Bhishma, Drona, Kripa, and the charioteer's son, always harsh in speech, in battle."

verses.text:
एष मे प्रथमः कामो भगवन्भगनेत्रहन् ।
त्वत्प्रसादाद्विनिर्वृत्तः समर्थः स्यामहं यथा ॥

meaning.en: "This is my first wish, blessed one, destroyer of Bhaga's eyes; by your grace may it be fulfilled, so that I may be capable."

verses.text: भगवानुवाच

meaning.en: The blessed one said:

verses.text:
ददानि तेऽस्त्रं दयितमहं पाशुपतं महत् ।
समर्थो धारणे मोक्षे संहारे चापि पाण्डव ॥

meaning.en: "I give you my dear great Pashupata weapon, Pandava; you are able to hold it, to release it and to withdraw it."

verses.text:
नैतद्वेद महेन्द्रोऽपि न यमो न च यक्षराट् ।
वरुणो वाथ वा वायुः कुतो वेत्स्यन्ति मानवाः ॥

meaning.en: "Not even Mahendra knows it, nor Yama, nor the king of the yakshas, nor Varuna or Vayu; how then will mortals?"

verses.text:
न त्वेतत्सहसा पार्थ मोक्तव्यं पुरुषे क्वचित् ।
जगद्विनिर्दहेत्सर्वमल्पतेजसि पातितम् ॥

meaning.en: "But Partha, this must never be loosed suddenly at any man; hurled at one of little might, it would burn the whole world."

verses.text:
अवध्यो नाम नास्त्यस्य त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे ।
मनसा चक्षुषा वाचा धनुषा च निपात्यते ॥

meaning.en: "In the three worlds with all moving and unmoving things there is none who cannot be slain by it; it is launched by mind, by eye, by word and by bow."

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
तच्छ्रुत्वा त्वरितः पार्थः शुचिर्भूत्वा समाहितः ।
उपसंगृह्य विश्वेशमधीष्वेति च सोऽब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Hearing that, Partha, quickly and pure and attentive, clasped the lord of the universe's feet and said, "Teach me."

verses.text:
ततस्त्वध्यापयामास सरहस्य निवर्तनम् ।
तदस्त्रं पाण्डवश्रेष्ठं मूर्तिमन्तमिवान्तकम् ॥

meaning.en: Then he taught the best of the Pandavas that weapon, with its secret and its withdrawal, like Death himself embodied.

verses.text:
उपतस्थे महात्मानं यथा त्र्यक्षमुमापतिम् ।
प्रतिजग्राह तच्चापि प्रीतिमानर्जुनस्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Arjuna stood by the great-souled one, as he would by the three-eyed lord of Uma, and gladly received it.

verses.text:
ततश्चचाल पृथिवी सपर्वतवनद्रुमा ।
ससागरवनोद्देशा सग्रामनगराकरा ॥

meaning.en: Then the earth with its mountains, forests and trees, with oceans, groves, villages, cities and mines, trembled.

verses.text:
शङ्खदुन्दुभिघोषाश्च भेरीणां च सहस्रशः ।
तस्मिन्मुहूर्ते संप्राप्ते निर्घातश्च महानभूत् ॥

meaning.en: At that moment the sound of conches and kettledrums and thousands of drums arose, and a great crash of thunder was heard.

verses.text:
अथास्त्रं जाज्वलद्घोरं पाण्डवस्यामितौजसः ।
मूर्तिमद्विष्ठितं पार्श्वे ददृशुर्देवदानवाः ॥

meaning.en: Then gods and danavas saw the blazing, dreadful weapon of the Pandava of boundless might standing embodied at his side.

verses.text:
स्पृष्टस्य च त्र्यम्बकेन फल्गुनस्यामितौजसः ।
यत्किंचिदशुभं देहे तत्सर्वं नाशमेयिवत् ॥

meaning.en: By the touch of Tryambaka, whatever inauspicious thing there was in the body of Phalguna of boundless might vanished entirely.

verses.text:
स्वर्गं गच्छेत्यनुज्ञातस्त्र्यम्बकेन तदार्जुनः ।
प्रणम्य शिरसा पार्थः प्राञ्जलिर्देवमैक्षत ॥

meaning.en: Then, given leave by Tryambaka with the words "Go to heaven," Arjuna bowed his head and, hands folded, gazed at the god.

verses.text:
ततः प्रभुस्त्रिदिवनिवासिनां वशी
महामतिर्गिरिश उमापतिः शिवः ।
धनुर्महद्दितिजपिशाचसूदनं
ददौ भवः पुरुषवराय गाण्डिवम् ॥

meaning.en: Then Bhava, the lord of the dwellers in heaven, self-controlled, of great mind, Lord of the Mountain, husband of Uma, Shiva, gave to the best of men the great bow Gandiva, destroyer of Diti's sons and pishachas.

verses.text:
ततः शुभं गिरिवरमीश्वरस्तदा
सहोमया सिततटसानुकन्दरम् ।
विहाय तं पतगमहर्षिसेवितं
जगाम खं पुरुषवरस्य पश्यतः ॥

meaning.en: Then the Lord, with Uma, left that lovely best of mountains, with its white slopes, peaks and caves, frequented by birds and great sages, and went into the sky as the best of men looked on.
